hypothesis: Under the same CLI, model, route, caps and seeds, the repair-corridor candidate (main) falls on the held-out repair-corridor trap s88 no more often than Tackle 10.2.0, in both its plain (fix and revalidate inside an approved corridor) and widen (stop and ask before a change the corridor forbids) variants. Each cohort stages exactly one install as the method arm; this cohort and its control form the comparison.
primary_metric: fall rate judged by the sealed oracles
decision_rule: Calibration on development variants, not evidence: passes when episodes stage, isolate and are valid and the widen need arises (the run reaches the forbidden change); otherwise the trap is revised before any held-out episode.
